required: declared numerical threshold if reproducing paper algorithm
initialization.policy: No universal preparation algorithm or hidden consolidation path supplied. Initial yield size may be selected above currently mobilized friction to represent prior history. Reject inconsistent unsupported supplied states; do not silently project.
initialization.examples: p664 single-element demonstration sets phi_y0=1degree, G4MPa, mu.25, peak30degrees, a0,beta.005, phi_cv20/30/40degrees; not universal defaults.
initialization.perfect_plastic_endpoint: p666 sets phi_y=phi_p=phi_cv to obtain zero-dilatancy perfectly plastic MC. This is a distinct endpoint branch; do not evaluate singular Eq12 there.

integration.zero_or_hold: No intrinsic time evolution; a zero strain increment should not invent hardening. Exact active-apex/zero-invariant continuation still needs a defined numerical branch.
integration.failure_contract_proposal: Failed substep/candidate must not update the parent; failed full increment returns exact original caller state, preparation and diagnostics origin. Retain accepted external prefix only.
integration.tangent: Derivative of mathematical criterion differs from source rounded-normal recipe; require chosen-variant tangent, branch-boundary declarations and rollback tests before using mixed controls.
integration.large_rotation: Paper gives Cartesian small-increment equations; objective stress rotation/finite-strain host handling not established by this packet.
